commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+5' Lamine Yamal fires in the corner, but the close-range bullet header from Mikel Oyarzabal (Spain) lacks accuracy and ends well wide of the left post.
90+5' Lamine Yamal (Spain) will take the corner.

90+5' Lamine Yamal (Spain) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The ball goes out for a corner. Spain can continue in their attacking effort.
